narration.text: X axis dropped into overtravel on a warm start. I check the guard-door proximity switch first.
There it is. Dust bridged across the sensor, so the controller reads the axis at its limit.
Alarm's clear. Same cause every few months. Clean it, don't replace it.

lesson.title: A false X-axis overtravel alarm is often a dust-bridged interlock sensor
lesson.body: Check the protective switch before replacing a limit switch; wipe the sensor face clean and confirm the bracket is square to the door.
